name: Eventtia
description_en:
Eventtia connects event pages, registration, communications, onsite access and analytics. It can support paid tickets, invited audiences, applications, groups, session choices and time slots. Higher packages add mobile/virtual experiences or structured B2B meetings. These scenarios require different registration and access rules even though they use one platform.

The current site also offers an MCP server so an AI assistant can read or act on an account’s event data with the user’s existing permissions. This is a tool-access model, not proof that every workflow is safe to automate. The core commercial unit is a registration credit valid within a twelve-month license.
description_zh:
Eventtia 连接活动页面、报名、沟通、现场访问及分析，支持售票、邀请、申请、团队、场次选择和时间预约。较高套餐增加移动/线上体验或结构化 B2B 会面，即便同平台，不同情境仍需不同报名与访问规则。

现行网站还提供 MCP，让 AI 助手以用户既有权限读取或操作活动数据。这是工具访问方式，不证明所有流程都适合自动执行。核心商业单位为 12 个月许可内有效的报名额度。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage attendee types, tickets, sessions and onsite access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理人员类型、票据、场次与现场访问。

core_features.name_zh: 受既有权限约束的 MCP 工具
core_features.explanation_en: Assistant access inherits the connected Eventtia account role.
core_features.explanation_zh: 助手继承连接账户的 Eventtia 角色。

en: Manage an invitation-only workshop with session access and pooled event credits.
zh: 使用共享活动额度管理受邀工作坊及场次访问。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define registration count and admin roles, confirm the quote and validate one attendee through session access before using AI write tools.
steps.zh: 定义报名数与管理员角色，确认报价，先核对一名参与者的场次访问，再启用 AI 写工具。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Twelve-month registration-credit pool or custom Enterprise per-admin licensing; optional services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: USD starting configurations for twelve months: Essential $1,650/250 registrations/one admin; Premium $2,500/two admins; Networking $3,500/three admins. One credit per registration; top-up rate agreed. Enterprise custom per-admin, usually above $12,000/year. No free trial. Optional messages, domains, services and payment-provider charges require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 美元 12 个月起始配置：Essential $1,650/250 条报名/1 管理员，Premium $2,500/2 管理员，Networking $3,500/3 管理员。每条报名一个额度，增购费率约定。Enterprise 按管理员定制、通常高于年 $12,000，无免费试用。消息、域名、服务及支付商费用需确认。

sources.title: Event management software for any event you run | Eventtia
sources.research_notes_en: Registration-to-check-in event platform; mobile, matchmaking and MCP distinct capabilities, permissions inherited rather than expanded.

sources.title: Our Plans & Pricing | Eventtia
sources.research_notes_en: Twelve-month attendee-credit plans, explicit no trial, Enterprise per-admin licensing and optional integration build/services.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Define one registration and its downstream permissions
sections.title_zh: 定义一条报名及其后续权限
sections.en: For an illustrative invitation-only workshop, configure eligibility, a registration form, session capacity and a confirmation, then verify QR access to the intended checkpoints. A general event confirmation should not grant every session. Premium adds a mobile app and virtual stage; Networking adds matchmaking and scheduled meetings. Check the intended plan instead of assuming the complete experience is included.
sections.zh: 例如受邀工作坊，应配置资格、表单、场次容量与确认，再核对二维码能进入哪些检查点。活动确认不应自动开放所有场次。Premium 增加应用及线上舞台，Networking 增加配对和预约会面，应确认套餐而不假设包含全部体验。

sections.title_en: One credit is one registration, not one unique human forever
sections.title_zh: 一个额度是一条报名，不是永久一个独立人
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says one credit equals one registration. Credits are pooled across unlimited events for twelve months; the same attendee registering for another event should not be assumed free. Essential starts USD $1,650/year for 250 attendees and one admin seat, Premium $2,500 with two seats, Networking $3,500 with three. Top-ups use the license’s agreed rate. These are starting configurations, not quotes for every volume or currency.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 说明一个额度对应一条报名，12 个月内跨不限活动共享，不能假定同一人再次报名免费。Essential 以 250 人、1 管理员为例年费起 USD $1,650，Premium $2,500、2 席位，Networking $3,500、3 席位。增购按许可约定费率。这些是起始配置，不是所有容量或币种报价。

sections.title_en: Separate enterprise licensing and optional work
sections.title_zh: 区分企业许可与可选工作
sections.en: Enterprise switches to custom per-admin licensing with unlimited attendees; the page says it usually starts above $12,000/year rather than offering a fixed amount. SSO, custom domains, SMS, premium support and integration build services require scope confirmation. A zero Eventtia per-registration platform fee does not establish that Stripe, another processor or message provider is free. No free trial is offered; the page describes a working discovery-call walkthrough instead.
sections.zh: Enterprise 改为按管理员定制许可、参与者不限，页面称通常高于每年 $12,000，而非固定价格。SSO、域名、短信、高级支持和集成搭建需确认范围。Eventtia 不加按报名平台费，不证明 Stripe、其他支付商或消息提供商免费。官网明确无免费试用，提供发现会议中的工作演示。

sections.title_en: Check tools and ownership before delegating event changes
sections.title_zh: 委派活动修改前核对工具与责任
sections.en: The MCP offer includes read and write access within the connected account role. Review which actions an assistant can perform before enabling it against live registrations. Use a disposable event to test an intended change, its auditability and recovery. Eventtia merits investigation for recurring event operations with pooled registration capacity; a one-off minimal RSVP may not need an annual license. No MCP call, payment, check-in, export, source license or self-hosted deployment was tested or established.
sections.zh: MCP 在连接角色内提供读写权限，接入真实报名之前，应确认助手能执行哪些动作。建议用可丢弃活动测试预期变更、可追溯性及恢复。需要共享报名容量的持续运营可以研究 Eventtia，简单单次 RSVP 未必需要年许可。本文未执行 MCP、支付、签到、导出，也未确认源码许可或自托管部署。

research_gaps: No account, MCP client, registration, payment, badge, matchmaking or export was tested.
Exact credit reuse/refunds, processor/message fees, API/build scope, contractual retention/residency, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
